map.多种方法估算家庭保险保障需求: Estimate family insurance protection needs by multiple methods
map.收入倍数法：保额 = 年收入 × 倍数；需求法：保额 = 家庭负债 + 年支出: Income-multiple method: cover = annual income × multiple; needs method: cover = family liabilities + annual expenses × coverage years − existing assets
map.依据收入倍数法与需求法估算寿险/重疾保额；经验参考保额约为年收入 10 倍、年保: Estimate life/critical-illness cover by the income-multiple and needs methods; as a rule of thumb the cover is about 10× annual income and the annual premium kept within 10% of annual income, for family protection planning.
map.最简单的保险规划方法，保额建议为年收入的10倍，以确保家庭在失去主要收入来源后仍: The simplest planning method: cover recommended at 10× annual income, so the family can maintain about 10 years of living standard after losing the main income source; keep premium spending within 10% of annual income to avoid an excessive burden.
map.家庭资产配置的经典法则，将收入按比例分配到不同用途，其中保险占比10%，保障型保: A classic family-asset-allocation rule that allocates income by proportion to different uses, with insurance at 10% and protection-type insurance prioritized.
map.以被保险人未来工作年限内的收入能力作为价值衡量，计算其对家庭的经济贡献现值。考虑: Use the insured's income capacity over future working years as the value measure, computing the present value of their economic contribution to the family; factoring income growth and discounting gives a more scientific life-cover estimate.
map.寿险保额 = 家庭负债 + 子女教育金 + 赡养费用 + 最终费用 + 生活支出: Life cover = family liabilities + children's education fund + support costs + final expenses + living-gap − existing assets
map.最全面的保险需求计算方法，从家庭实际需求出发，逐项计算各项费用缺口，确保保险覆盖: The most comprehensive needs method: starting from real family needs, compute each expense gap item by item to ensure insurance covers all family responsibilities.
map.评估保额、保费与杠杆是否足够: Assess whether cover, premium and leverage are sufficient
map.算不同缴费期的总支出: Compute total outlay across different payment terms
map.年保费 3000、保额 100 万，杠杆约 333 倍（首年），是保险的放大保障: Annual premium 3000, cover 1 million, leverage ≈ 333× (first year) — the essence of insurance's amplified protection; but check the terms, waiting period and exclusions.
map.长期缴总保费更高但年压力小、且含豁免可能；短期缴总成本低。结合现金流与保障需求选: Long-term payment has higher total premium but lower annual pressure and may include waivers; short-term has lower total cost. Choose by cash flow and protection needs.
map.保费和保额关系？: What is the relationship between premium and cover?
map.保额是出险赔多少，保费是你交多少；杠杆=保额/保费。年轻健康时杠杆高，年龄大或带: Cover is how much is paid on a claim, premium is what you pay; leverage = cover / premium. When young and healthy leverage is high; older or ill, premium spikes or cover is declined.
map.免赔额以下自己承担、以上才赔。免赔越高保费越低；小额医疗选低免赔体验好但保费贵，: Below the deductible you bear it yourself, above it the insurer pays. Higher deductible → lower premium; for small medical needs a low deductible feels better but costs more, for large risks a high deductible saves more.
map.保险需求计算器。保险需求计算器。用收入倍数法、需求法等估算家庭寿险/重疾等保障额: Insurance Needs Calculator. Insurance needs calculator. Estimate family life/critical-illness cover by income-multiple and needs methods; recommended cover 10× annual income, premium within 10% of annual income, aiding family protection planning.
map.覆盖大病期间收入损失、康复费用、护理费用等，建议3-5倍年收入: Covers income loss, recovery and nursing costs during a serious illness; 3-5× annual income is recommended
map.覆盖家庭负债、子女教育、赡养老人等家庭责任: Covers family debts, children's education and support for elderly parents
map.意外身故/伤残保障，杠杆高，建议年收入10倍: Covers accidental death and disability, high leverage, 10× annual income is recommended
map.报销住院医疗费用，保费低、保额高，人手必备: Reimburses hospital costs, low premium and high cover, essential for everyone
